answer: Sybil resistance works when identity is expensive and trust is earned, not minted. Each agent must lock a refundable bond to register, and reputation only flows across a bridge of peer attestations that is rate-limited per unit of staked capital. To forge N identities an attacker must post N bonds and still earn attestations one slow step at a time, so fake trust leaks away like water through karst. Honest nodes root deep like cedar; the attacker pays linearly in locked collateral and slash risk while gaining only sublinear influence.
